name: Content Type Audit
description: Admin report of the node count per content type, with published-status and created-date filters.
project_description: The Content Type Audit module provides a simple report of the number of nodes for each content type in your Drupal site. The report lives under Reports at /admin/reports/content-type and is a single AJAX form: pick a published status (Any / Published / Unpublished) and an optional created-date range, then Apply Filters to see a table of every content type with its node count, a grand total, and a "View All Pages" link into the core content overview (filtered by that type and status). Content types with no matching nodes still appear with a count of 0, which makes it easy to spot unused types for cleanup or migration planning. Access is gated by the core 'administer content types' permission.
